detail: Preserve this simple medication verification page. Make only two deletions to avoid duplication: remove the duplicated Reported medication / Adderall fact because Adderall is already the medication row title; remove the separate result-status strip at bottom because expected substances are already shown with the medications and the next step reviews results. Keep one titleAdderall, Active, expectedsubstanceAMP, configuredcritical-expectation/Confirmationrequired No, Edit, Discontinue, Addmedication and verifiedlistcheckbox. Do not add othermedications or any medication imagery. Keep photoidentityheader, native sidebar, footer and all other styling/layout.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied design concept, not application code. Preserve the clean simple layout, typography and blue primary actions of the EARLIER design. No extra cards, metrics or instructional paragraphs. Fictional sample data. Use one conventional light Payload v3 sidebar, 220px wide, with MI Drug Test logo and collapse control; only four compact extension actions Collect Test (blue), Quick Book (neutral), Test Tracker (neutral), Collect Payment (neutral), followed by the NATIVE collapsible Collections group containing Clients, and Referrals group containing Courts and Employers. Native links plain text, no new app sidebar or second sidebar, no version text. Preserve existing blue primary actions in content. On selected-client collection pages, use ONE compact identity row about 80px high, with a clear 56px photo headshot of fictional Alex Morgan (adult short dark hair, gray shirt), name, DOB Jan 14 1990, current test, and Edit link. Do not repeat name or test elsewhere. Keep phase progress Client / Payment / Prepare / Details / Review. No medication photos, drawings, pill illustrations or decorative medical imagery. Only medication verification step lists actual medications; other steps do not repeat medication cards. Results only use a small colored strip after a report exists. Green negative/expected-positive, yellow review/warning/pending, red unexpected findings; always label meaning. Before upload no inferred negative. Editing optional test details is collapsed by default. Do not add duplicated summaries, profile facts, payments, warnings or buttons.
